author: bondmila (AI-assisted)
summary: Add debounced context request coordinator and cancellable Pi HTTP client
details: Add opt-in release-to-arm input, one outstanding request, ten-second cooldown/rate cap, second-press/manual/priority cancellation and original-capture expiry. HTTPS client uses only the private Pi credential, preserves lineage and rejects retimed/advisory replies. No GPIO, speech or motor output; existing applications/deployment unchanged. Physical and application integration remain explicit limits.
validation: 28 new button/client tests and 116 full edge tests passed; 82 root tests passed. Includes in-process accepted context endpoint with fake provider and actual child termination/reaping. Checked publisher reruns shared checks and generated changelog validation. No hardware/public service/API acceptance.
